name: Kentucky

period.description: Your spend-down is figured over a three-month period; coverage starts on the day your bills use up your extra income.

submission.description: Bring or send your medical bills to your DCBS caseworker. Proof that you owe a bill is enough; you do not have to have paid it.

notes: Health insurance premiums, doctor visits and prescriptions you pay can count.
Old bills count only if still unpaid at the start of the three-month period and not used before.
The exact day you meet your spend-down is the day your coverage starts.
